annotations.text:
Start here. Expand this artboard and click through it — the six nav tabs switch views, the type pills and search box filter the list, and clicking any memory row opens the detail drawer.

Two new proposals are live in here: the task tray (the spinner button in the top bar, click to open) and retrieval explain (Recall → 'Why this answer?' under the answer panel). Both render data the daemon already returns.

Three tweaks sit above the frame: accent colour, comfortable/compact row density, and daemon state — flip that to 'degraded' to see the side-panel status block in its unhappy form.

The memory contents are real facts lifted from AGENTS.md. The counts, timings and spend figures are sample values — plausible, not measured. Swap them before showing this to anyone who might read them as metrics.
